capabilities: Catalogue 2 euro coin issues and mint variants as Markdown notes with frontmatter
Synchronize coin data and obverse images from Numista
Track ownership, quantity, acquisition date, price, and condition per coin
Filter and sort a coin dashboard by country, year, ownership, and type
Download, lock, reference, and batch-process coin cover images
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Numista catalogue data and images remain subject to Numista terms, and photo attribution fields must be kept when redistributing images.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to maintain a structured collectible catalogue with per-item notes, images, and ownership status.

relations.evidence: Synchronizes official standard-circulation and circulating commemorative 2 euro issues from Numista.

summary: Coin catalogue plugin that stores 2 euro coins as Markdown notes with Numista synchronization, cover images, ownership tracking, and a filterable dashboard.
